items.title: Biophilic Palm Frond and Leaf Cluster CNC Pattern
items.description: Create a harmonious, organic connection in your architectural projects with this biophilic design featuring a high-density repeating pattern of stylized palm fronds and leaf clusters. Available for instant download in production-ready DXF, SVG, and DWG vectors, this file is specifically engineered for projects requiring maximum privacy while allowing natural light and airflow. Ideal for fabricating outdoor balcony railings, protective architectural window screens, and dynamic feature wall cladding in residential and hospitality spaces.

items.title: Chain Link Border Floral Medallion DXF Slat Panel
items.description: This design is free to cut and pairs a repeating chain-link border with small tribal-style corner accents around wide horizontal slats and a central dotted floral wreath. The chain motif gives the border a mechanical, almost industrial rhythm that contrasts nicely with the softer floral center.
items.pin_text:
Chain Link Border Floral Medallion DXF Slat Panel

This design is free to cut and pairs a repeating chain-link border with small tribal-style corner accents around wide horizontal slats and a central dotted floral wreath. The chain motif gives the border a mechanical, almost industrial rhythm that contrasts nicely with the softer floral center.
